summary: Ready for school: a help desk that routes tickets to IT, FBRX OS Education for student computers, presenter-safe mode, UniFi network environments in Ultra, and updates FBRX Command can push.
notes: Help desk: once a computer belongs to an organization, a Help desk tab sends problems to IT through FBRX Command, live, to the computers chosen as receivers.
FBRX OS Education: student computers get a simple set of pages and a safe learning helper with no tools. Education licenses put staff computers in classroom mode.
Presenter-safe mode in every edition: quiet notifications, masked clipboard history and blurred private lists while you present (Ctrl+Alt+P, or on by itself with a projector).
Endpoint Ultra: attach your UniFi console in Network Center → Environments to see and manage the whole network, with guest Wi-Fi codes.
Endpoint Basic is simpler: IT tools such as Task Manager, Copy & migrate and the bug catcher move to Ultra.
FBRX Command can install updates on every computer by itself or on demand, and makes Mac profiles and Intune scripts for device managers.
